question: Who has won the most individual gold Olympic medals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Michael Phelps.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Michael Phelps:-**

 
 
• **He has won the most individual gold Olympic medals with a total of 23 gold medals in his career.**
 
• He is a retired American swimmer who participated in five Olympic games from 2000 to 2016 and won a total of 28 medals.
 
• Phelps is widely regarded as one of the greatest swimmers of all time and has set numerous world records during his career.
 
• His most successful Olympic games were in Beijing 2008 where he won eight gold medals in a single games, breaking the record for the most gold medals won in a single Olympic games.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simone Biles:-**

 
 
• She is an American gymnast who has won a total of 7 Olympic medals, including 4 gold medals in the 2016 Rio Olympics. 
 
 
 
• **Katie Ledecky:-**
 
 
• She is an American swimmer who has won a total of 6 Olympic medals, including 5 gold medals.
 
 
 
• **Usain Bolt:-**
 
 
• He is a Jamaican sprinter who has won a total of 8 Olympic medals, including 6 gold medals.
